name: pnpm
description: Fast, disk space efficient package manager with strict dependency management

tools.description: Performant npm alternative with content-addressable storage and strict dependency isolation
tools.usage:
pnpm install # Install dependencies
pnpm add package-name # Add new package
pnpm run build # Run package script
pnpm create vite my-app # Create new project
pnpm store prune # Clean unused packages from store
